value.rationale: The result corrects a central structural premise of a published chaotic-flow analysis: equilibrium stability is used there to motivate the hidden-attractor classification. Replacing that premise by exact unstable dimensions two and three changes the local dynamical picture, while the exceptional equilibrium line supplies a natural parameter boundary omitted from the source. The pointwise divergence correction also prevents a common but consequential volume-contraction inference. These are mathematically motivated corrections, not arbitrary parameter recomputations.
